implementation.targetScope: PNG.sync.read for application figure validation and RGBA pixel inspection. Static/default PNG image decoding: five color types, legal sample depths, transparency, all filters and Adam7. No writer, stream parser, constructor or gamma adjustment API.

changes: Independent bounded chunk parser, scanline reconstruction and sample conversion, using supported-runtime zlib inflate and CRC32.
Input and pixel bounds before bitmap allocation; exact inflated lengths including Adam7 passes and strict chunk ordering/CRC checks.
No PNG stream/writer implementation, compatibility shims or third-party runtime dependencies; app uses synchronous reading only.
Follow PNG decoder compatibility rules for final IDAT padding, transparency-key high bits and empty palette transparency.

verification.corpus: 162 exact valid PNG comparisons; 14 invalid files rejected. Missing-IDAT upstream outcome is runtime/state-dependent and not an equality control. Corpus revision and hashes live in scripts/png-conformance/images.json.

application.tests: 28 unchanged problemImage tests pass against upstream and VPM on Bun 1.4.0; source copies temporary only.

verification.limitations: No writer, async parser, PNG constructor, bitblt, gamma adjustment, 16-bit skipRescale output or animation-frame API. Resource defaults match app bounds; no adoption or release claim.
